description.value:
As an action, you designate a point within 60 feet. Any creatures you choose within 30 feet of that point must make a Constitution saving throw against your universal force save DC, taking 5d10 force damage and gaining 1 level of exhaustion on a failure, or half damage and no exhaustion on a success.

For each creature that fails its save, one friendly creature within 30 feet of it can regain hit points equal to the damage that was dealt, though no friendly creature can benefit from this more than once per turn.

You can use this feature six times, with all uses restored after a long rest.
